en-US.title: Tunnel Advance Rate
en-US.intro: Estimate cycle advance, cycles per day, daily and monthly advance from hole depth, utilization and process times. Invalid inputs clear old results, and zero daily advance produces no schedule estimate.

en-US.title: Tunnel Lining Thickness
en-US.intro: Estimate primary and secondary lining thickness from rock class and span using empirical coefficients (k=0.04–0.10). This is an empirical preliminary estimate, not a load-structure safety check; formal design requires separate structural analysis and reinforcement verification.

zh-CN.title: 隧道支护参数设计
zh-CN.intro: 输入围岩级别、跨度、高度与断面/支护范围，按经验系数估算锚杆长度、间距、喷层厚度与每延米锚杆数；支护展开长度按选中几何计算（半圆拱/矩形顶板+侧壁/矩形全周长），结果仅为方案粗估。

en-US.title: Tunnel Support Design
en-US.intro: Estimate bolt length, spacing, shotcrete thickness and bolts per metre from rock class, span, height and selected support geometry. The developed length follows the chosen shape; results are preliminary estimates only.

en-US.title: Ventilation Calc
en-US.intro: Estimate required airflow and air changes using the control-velocity method or highway CO dilution. Personnel airflow is not computed here and must be designed separately to applicable standards and work intensity.

en-US.title: Tunnel Gas Monitoring Reference
en-US.intro: Enter methane concentration from 0 to 100 %VOL for classification and response. Concentrations above the upper explosive limit remain high-risk (asphyxiation and explosive if diluted); thresholds and actions must be verified by professionals.
